title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2608.14221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoformalization is commonly framed as translating natural-language mathematical statements into machine-verifiable formal languages such as Lean 4. However, faithful formalization requires more than translation. Models must map mathematical concepts to the complex hierarchy of types and definitions in formal libraries such as Mathlib, while ensuring that generated statements preserve the meaning of the source propositions. Existing approaches struggle because they rely heavily on the model's parametric memory for library-specific knowledge, while common data construction pipelines often resort to filtering single-pass outputs and lack mechanisms for feedback-driven revision. To address these challenges, we introduce MathForm, an autoformalization framework for constructing verified training data through Mathlib knowledge retrieval and verification-guided iterative refinement. translated_title: MathForm：借助知识检索与验证引导改进实现数学自动形式化的规模化
translated_abstract: 自动形式化通常被理解为将自然语言数学陈述翻译成机器可验证的形式语言（如Lean 4）。然而，忠实的形式化不仅仅是翻译。模型必须将数学概念映射到形式化库（如Mathlib）中复杂的类型和定义层级，同时确保生成的陈述保留源命题的含义。现有方法面临挑战，因为它们严重依赖模型的参数记忆来获取库特定知识，而常见的数据构建流程往往诉诸于过滤单次输出，缺乏反馈驱动的修订机制。为解决这些问题，我们引入了MathForm，一个通过Mathlib知识检索和验证引导的迭代改进来构建验证训练数据的自动形式化框架。在生成之前，一个检索规划器收集相关定义。
tldr: MathForm通过知识检索和验证引导的迭代改进，解决了自动形式化中库知识依赖和缺乏反馈修订的问题，实现了数学陈述的忠实形式化。
en_tdlr: MathForm addresses the challenges of library-knowledge reliance and lack of feedback-driven revision in autoformalization through knowledge retrieval and verification-guided iterative refinement, enabling faithful formalization of mathematical statements.
